mechanism: Replace the particle diagonal second moment by the EMA of full gradient Gram matrices G^T G/N. Bias correct, then use H=(V + trace(V)/d I)/2, a fixed trace-preserving isotropic shrinkage, and multiply row first moments by H^(-1/2) with original epsilon. Original betas/LR and network Adam retained. No displacement clipping.
rationale: Three diagonal/trust variants preserve rare shape but fail ring. Shared_coordinate pools rows yet ignores correlations; a rotation-equivariant matrix preconditioner changes directions coherently and regularizes low-rank gradient geometry without target information.
optimizer_updates: One D plus one G/particle update per frozen iteration; particle custom update substitutes original Adam table update.
extra_work: One O(N*d^2) gradient Gram, one O(d^3) symmetric eigendecomposition, one O(N*d^2) matrix product each particle update. No extra network forward/backward or optimizer updates; equal-step only, not equal-compute.
